scope: Native Filesystem POSIX file size and sparse write vertical slice
required_user_semantics: truncate shrink publishes a smaller exact file version before returning
truncate grow publishes the larger size and reads the new range as zero without allocating by hole length
pwrite beyond EOF creates a zero-filled sparse hole and allocates only the written patch payload
open with O_TRUNC clears the file atomically before open returns
concurrent O_APPEND writes choose disjoint offsets, every record appears exactly once
Node A mutation is visible through Node B on the first following stat/read
Meta and Node B restart preserve the committed file size and content binding
required_observability: Arena logical bytes delta for sparse grow and sparse pwrite
non_goals: hard link and symbolic link semantics
